Class Database

java.lang.Object
database.Database
public class Database extends Object

Title: Database Class.

Description: This is an in-memory database built on H2. Detailed documentation of H2 can be found at https://www.h2database.com/html/main.html (Click on "PDF (2MB)" on the l3ft side of the page under the heading "Reference" for a PDF of 438 pages.) This class leverages H2 and provides numerous special supporting methods.

  • Method Details

    • addLesson

      public void addLesson(entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson)
      Inserts a new lesson into the lessons table. Only the author, title, and text are stored; the ID is generated by the database and the lock flags take their default value of false. A SQLException is caught and its stack trace printed, so a failed insert is not reported to the caller.
      Parameters:
      lesson - the lesson to store

    • getLessonByAuthor

      public entityClasses.LessonsLearnedCollection getLessonByAuthor(String author)
      Retrieves every lesson written by the given author.
      Parameters:
      author - the username of the author whose lessons are wanted
      Returns:
      a collection of that author's lessons, including their IDs and lock flags; the collection is empty if the author has no lessons or a database error occurs

    • getLessonByID

      public entityClasses.LessonsLearned getLessonByID(int id)
      Retrieves a single lesson by its ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique ID of the lesson
      Returns:
      the matching lesson, or null if no lesson has that ID or a database error occurs

    • updateLesson

      public boolean updateLesson(int id, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson)
      Updates the author, title, and text of an existing lesson. The ID and lock flags are not changed.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the lesson to update
      lesson - a lesson holding the new author, title, and text
      Returns:
      true if exactly one row was updated; false if no lesson has that ID or a database error occurs

    • generateInvitationCode

      public String generateInvitationCode(String emailAddress, String role)

      Method: String generateInvitationCode(String emailAddress, String role)

      Description: Given an email address and a roles, this method establishes and invitation code and adds a record to the InvitationCodes table. When the invitation code is used, the stored email address is used to establish the new user and the record is removed from the table.

      Parameters:
      emailAddress - specifies the email address for this new user.
      role - specified the role that this new user will play.
      Returns:
      the code of six characters so the new user can use it to securely setup an account.

    • requireExperienceAccess

      private void requireExperienceAccess(String contributor, int lessonId) throws SQLException
      Checks current account permissions against persisted data, not the UI's role flag. This feature follows the existing Contributor home policy of author-owned lessons. Missing and inaccessible lessons share an error to avoid exposing another user's data.
      Throws:
      SQLException

    • addExperience

      public long addExperience(String contributor, int lessonId, String whatDone, String howDone, String elapsedMinutes, String memberEffort) throws SQLException
      Appends one experience without changing the lesson or any earlier attempts. LessonExperience validates the same inputs for GUI and direct database callers. SQL failures propagate so the interface cannot report a failed insert as successful.
      Parameters:
      contributor - signed-in contributor
      lessonId - existing owned lesson
      whatDone - what was done during this attempt
      howDone - how the lesson was applied
      elapsedMinutes - positive decimal minutes
      memberEffort - one Member name: minutes entry per line
      Returns:
      generated attempt ID
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid data or inaccessible lessons
      SQLException - if persistence fails

    • getExperiences

      public List<LessonExperience> getExperiences(String contributor, int lessonId) throws SQLException
      Reads an owned lesson's attempts in creation order; an empty history is valid.
      Parameters:
      contributor - signed-in contributor
      lessonId - existing owned lesson
      Returns:
      independent immutable list of saved attempts
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for an invalid or inaccessible lesson
      SQLException - if the history cannot be read
